uniform_bounds.scope: For every anchor a>=threshold, bounds on R_a^(j)(y) for every real |y-a|<=1, where R_a=log(I/Q_a) and Q_a is frozen at a.

saddle_bound.scope: Every real x>=threshold, with L(x)=sqrt(window_factor*W(2x/pi)/2); model retains exact amplitude.

theta_bound.scope: For every anchor a>=threshold, Phi(v)-phi1(v)<=high*phi1(v) for v>=u(a)*exp(-L(a)/sqrt(A(a))); global*phi1(v) bounds the omitted sum for every v>=0.
theta_bound.proof: Geometric theta sum and exp(-z)<=order!/z^order; u(a)/a and u(a)*h(a) decrease.
